title: Bitpanda launches Staking
description: Bitpanda announced Staking with weekly rewards and no general lock-in or warm-up period for the initial supported assets.
notes: This establishes the Bitpanda Staking product from May 2022 but is not treated as the original launch date of the later Bitpanda Earn umbrella.

title: Bitpanda adds Earn on Stablecoins to the Bitpanda Earn suite
description: Bitpanda introduced Earn on Stablecoins for USDC and EURCV as part of the Bitpanda Earn suite and described the product as a stablecoin loan/title-transfer arrangement with a 14-day redemption period and explicit counterparty risk.
notes: Product-specific launch. It does not replace or redefine the separate staking mechanism.

title: CEX.IO Savings enters open beta under CEX.IO Earn
description: CEX.IO stated that Savings entered open beta as a full-fledged service under the CEX.IO Earn umbrella, initially with Flexible Savings and staking-related and stablecoin assets.
notes: This establishes Savings under the Earn umbrella by April 2021 but is not treated as proof of the umbrella's original launch date.

title: CEX.IO suspends Automated Crypto Staking program
description: CEX.IO announced suspension of its older Automated Crypto Staking program effective 1 April 2025 while separately updating the reward structure for continuing Staking and Savings programs.
notes: The event affects Automated Staking only. It is not treated as an end of the CEX.IO Earn umbrella or of all staking and savings products.
